title: Cricothyroid membrane palpation
view: Anterior (A-P) view of the neck, patient supine, head at the top: the operator's view.
teachingPoint: The membrane is the soft gap between the thyroid cartilage above and the cricoid ring below. Horizontal membrane incision; if it cannot be felt, a vertical midline skin incision centred on it first.
claims: Anterior view, head at the top: hyoid, thyroid cartilage with its notch, cricothyroid membrane, cricoid ring, tracheal rings.
The cricothyroid membrane lies between the lower border of the thyroid cartilage and the cricoid.
The cricoid is a complete ring, taller than a tracheal ring.
The thyroid isthmus crosses tracheal rings 2 to 4, below the cricoid and clear of the membrane; the lobes lie either side.
The solid red line is the horizontal membrane incision, within the membrane.

The dashed red line is the vertical midline skin incision for an impalpable membrane, 9 cm long (the record says 8-10 cm). Centring it on the membrane is the drawing's choice; the record gives the length, not the position - confirm or move it.
Three labels: Thyroid cartilage, Cricothyroid membrane, Cricoid cartilage.

geometry.why: thyroid cartilage is below the hyoid
membrane is below the thyroid cartilage
tracheal rings are below the cricoid
membrane incision is in the membrane
membrane incision does not cut the thyroid cartilage
membrane incision does not cut the cricoid
vertical skin incision runs over the membrane
vertical skin incision is 8-10 cm at 9 px/mm
